title: Viva Glint: multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options
summary: The briefing distinguishes the roadmap's planned search behaviour from the CSV capability already described in Learn. Its licensing, roles, reporting safeguards and live-survey restrictions are supported, and targeted searches found no separate feature switch or feature-specific charge.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options for Viva Glint administrators.
claims.quote: Viva Glint administrators will be able to create multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options

claims.claim: The roadmap plans uploading response options using a CSV file.
claims.quote: upload options using a CSV file.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The roadmap describes survey-taker search and filtering for questions containing more than 50 options.
claims.quote: For questions containing more than 50 options, survey takers can search and filter the available responses

claims.claim: The roadmap says reporting will support the expanded option set.
claims.quote: Reporting will support the expanded option set.

claims.claim: Learn documents CSV upload to add multiple-choice response options in bulk rather than individually.
claims.quote: Survey admins can upload a CSV file to add multiple choice response options in bulk, rather than entering each option individually.

claims.claim: Learn documents support for up to 500 options per question.
claims.quote: Supports up to 500 options per question.

claims.claim: CSV upload for option fields is documented as an editable Multiple Choice question field.
claims.quote: | CSV upload for option fields | Survey admins can upload a CSV file to add multiple choice response options in bulk, rather than entering each option individually. Supports up to 500 options per question. | Multiple Choice | Editable |

claims.claim: The Questions setup documentation applies only to Engagement survey programs.
claims.quote: This documentation applies only to Engagement survey programs.

claims.claim: The Questions setup page directs 360 feedback programs to separate documentation.
claims.quote: If you are creating a 360 feedback program, please refer to the 360-specific documentation

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe survey-taker search and filtering for long response lists.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint multiple choice 500 options search filter rollout 360. Read Questions setup, Multiple Choice Question Report and 360 Survey Questions setup; none documents survey-taker search of long option lists.

claims.claim: Rollout mechanics for response search are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint multiple choice 500 options search filter rollout 360. Read Questions setup and the roadmap record; neither states how response search rolls out.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The documented CSV capability is user-opt-in: survey authors choose to use the editable upload field.
claims.quote: Survey admins can upload a CSV file to add multiple choice response options in bulk, rather than entering each option individually.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The capability is included within Viva Glint's product entitlement, which requires a Viva Suite or Viva Glint subscription plan.
claims.quote: The purchase of a Viva Suite or Viva Glint subscription plan is required for using Microsoft Viva Glint.

claims.claim: Individual user licence assignment is not required for using Viva Glint.
claims.quote: Individual user license assignment isn't required for using Viva Glint.

claims.claim: Individual user licence assignment is required for the Pulse-Glint integration.
claims.quote: Individual user license assignment is required if you're planning on using the Pulse-Glint integration to take actions with Viva Pulse after Viva Glint engagement surveys.

claims.where: summary; front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A licence specific to the 500-option capability is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint 500 multiple choice options CSV pricing licensing charge meter. Read Viva Glint licensing and Questions setup; the former states the product subscription requirement and neither names a feature-specific licence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A price or charge specific to the 500-option capability is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint 500 multiple choice options CSV pricing licensing charge meter. Read Questions setup and Viva Glint licensing; neither publishes a price or charge for the 500-option capability.

claims.claim: The Questions setup page gives no price or meter for CSV upload.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint 500 multiple choice options CSV pricing licensing charge meter. Read the full Questions setup page, including Editable question fields; it describes CSV upload but gives no price or billing meter.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Viva Glint Service Administrators set up programs, surveys, distribution lists and reporting features.
claims.quote: Sets up programs and surveys, distribution lists, and reporting features

claims.claim: The Questions setup page is written for a Viva Glint Administrator.
claims.quote: As a Microsoft Viva Glint Administrator, use the Questions section to manage survey items

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or Viva Glint Tenant Administrator assigns the Viva Glint Service Administrator role.
claims.quote: Assigned by the M365 Global Administrator or the Viva Glint Tenant Administrator to have responsibility for admin tasks in the Viva Glint platform

claims.claim: The Multiple Choice Question Report lists response options vertically.
claims.quote: The Multiple Choice Question Report shows a table for each question, listing the response options from the question vertically.

claims.claim: The report shows response percentages broken down by the attribute selected for the section.
claims.quote: Horizontally, each response shows a percentage broken down by the attribute selected for the section.

claims.claim: The default minimum response threshold for multiple-choice items is five.
claims.quote: By default, the minimum response threshold for rating or multiple-choice items is five.

claims.claim: Responses below a team's minimum response threshold are aggregated and rolled up to the next level rather than reported for that team.
claims.quote: If the minimum response threshold isn't met for a user's team, their responses aren't reported. Instead, responses are aggregated with and rolled up to the next level.

claims.claim: Overwriting an existing option with a different label causes reporting trend issues.
claims.quote: Overwriting an existing option with a different/new label causes trend issues in reports and confusion in raw data exports.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Relabelling an existing option causes confusion in raw data exports.
claims.quote: Overwriting an existing option with a different/new label causes trend issues in reports and confusion in raw data exports.

claims.claim: Microsoft instructs administrators to use '+ Add new choice' to add a multiple-choice response option.
claims.quote: To add a new response option to Multiple Choice/Multi-Select questions, always use the "+ Add new choice" feature.

claims.claim: Microsoft instructs administrators to switch the Show toggle to Hide to retire an option.
claims.quote: Switch the "Show" toggle to "Hide" to retire an option.

claims.claim: Multiple-choice options should not be adjusted during a live survey and their editing fields are disabled until it is no longer live.
claims.quote: don't adjust any rating scale or multiple-choice options. ... You can edit language text, instruction text, and comment placeholder text only. Other fields are disabled and can't be edited until the survey is no longer live.

claims.claim: Survey authors update translations for questions used in multiple languages.
claims.quote: If your survey uses multiple languages, select each language from the Language dropdown menu to update translations.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes a question-type enhancement without naming a new identity, permission, sign-in or data source.
claims.quote: Viva Glint administrators will be able to create multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options and upload options using a CSV file.

claims.claim: The roadmap item describes no automated action.
claims.quote: For questions containing more than 50 options, survey takers can search and filter the available responses, making longer lists faster and easier to navigate. Reporting will support the expanded option set.

claims.where: controls[0]: ui and api; summary; Governance controls
claims.claim: No tenant or survey-level UI switch or automation for enabling or disabling the long-list limit, CSV upload or response search is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint 500 options CSV enable disable tenant survey switch PowerShell Graph API; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph Viva Glint survey question options CSV settings API. Read Questions setup and Advanced Configuration search excerpts; no separate switch or operation found.

claims.claim: Learn does not state that the 500-option limit applies outside the Engagement programs covered by Questions setup, such as 360.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint multiple choice 500 options search filter rollout 360. Read Questions setup and Microsoft Viva Glint 360 Survey Questions setup; the former limits its documentation to Engagement and the latter does not state a 500-option limit.
